summary: Backend-only verification of customer full-screen reschedule-ring parity with booking_confirmed. 6/6 pytest cases pass (iter215 2/2 + iter216 4/4). Verified: (1) partner-initiated reschedule → customer SSE 'reschedule_request' with correct payload shape; (2) push_dispatch.push_to_user is invoked for the customer (observable notification_delivery_logs row 'Reschedule request' even with FCM 'skipped: not_configured'); (3) partner accept → push_dispatch invoked for customer (notification_delivery_logs 'Booking confirmed') — booking_confirmed path untouched/no regression; (4) permissions — requester (partner) gets 403 on /reschedule/respond, opposite party (customer) accepting returns 200 and scheduled_at is updated; (5) customer-initiated reschedule still rings the partner (regression); (6) booking_controller source parity — both reschedule_request and booking_confirmed push branches use data_only=True, android_channel='azo-ring-silent-v1', tag families 'resched-{id}' / 'booking-{id}', and include title+body+android_channel in the data payload. Static review of Customer app notifications.ts & CustomerAlertOverlay.tsx matches spec (see critical_code_review_comments).

critical_code_review_comments: booking_controller.request_reschedule L1037: target_id = partner_id if role=='customer' else customer_id — correctly rings the OPPOSITE party for both directions. Clean.

booking_controller.request_reschedule L1066 push=False intentionally suppresses the notify-tray push so BOTH parties get only the full-screen data_only call-style ring (prevents double notifications). This matches the spec comment at L1062-1065.

booking_controller.request_reschedule L1077-1091 push_to_user payload is a structural MIRROR of accept_job L2791-2804: data_only=True, android_channel='azo-ring-silent-v1', tag resched-/booking-{id}, title+body embedded in data for the web SW path. True parity achieved.
booking_controller.respond_reschedule L1109-1110 correctly 403s the requester; L1119 $sets scheduled_at + schedule_type='schedule' and clears reschedule_request atomically on accept.

fcm_service.send_to_user writes notification_delivery_logs even when FCM is skipped ('skipped: not_configured') — this gives tests a cross-process observable to confirm push_to_user was actually invoked, which is exactly how both ring paths are verified here. Good.

Customer/src/lib/notifications.ts: displayRescheduleRing and displayBookingRing are byte-for-byte parallel in Notifee options (channel, category, fullScreenAction, importance, visibility, timeouts, iOS critical/timeSensitive). Both post the native notification FIRST and defer ring-status telemetry via async callback — guarantees the ring is shown even if /api/notifications/ring-status is slow/unreachable.

Customer/src/components/customer/CustomerAlertOverlay.tsx L84: 'cancelRescheduleRing only when AppState==active' is correct — if the user is on another app / phone locked, the native full-screen ring must keep ringing until they bring the Customer app to foreground (parity with booking_confirmed being one-time and cancellable immediately).

No regressions found in the booking_confirmed accept path — _job_brief + ring payload + push_to_user shape unchanged, verified by existing partner-flow tests + the new iter216 booking_confirmed delivery-log check.

rca of the issue: The customer app previously did NOT get a full-screen alert on a partner-initiated reschedule because the backend was sending a tray notification (notify(..., push=True)) and NOT a data-only Notifee ring push. Fix (already in codebase at L1066 push=False + L1075-1093 push_dispatch.push_to_user(..., data_only=True, android_channel='azo-ring-silent-v1', tag='resched-{id}')) makes the backend emit the EXACT same data shape used for booking_confirmed (L2789-2806), which the Customer app's displayRescheduleRing (notifications.ts L332) renders as a Notifee full-screen call-style notification — identical to displayBookingRing. Both backend tests (SSE + delivery-log) and static-review of Customer notifications.ts/CustomerAlertOverlay.tsx confirm parity with booking_confirmed and no regression.
